planes.description: Four affine matrix columns dotted with a three-component point plus row4 translation, x87 64-bit intermediate arithmetic and float32 output. Native computes columns1,2,3 before0, allowing point/output identity; portable produces a fresh array.

outside.description: Optionally transform through object matrix, then always through prepared global view matrix. Reject if radius+(viewZ-near)<0 or radius+(far-viewZ)<0 using unstored x87 sums. Otherwise evaluate four prepared affine plane distances and reject any float32 result below negative radius. All boundary equalities count inside. Plane/view preparation and camera lifetime remain external.

native.method: Original sphere culling, affine point transform and four-plane transform execute unchanged; finite x87 reference arithmetic, exact plane output bits, complete input/global-region collateral-write checks.

limits: Finite coordinates/matrices/radius/near/far with finite float32 transform outputs. View and plane matrix preparation are supplied records.
Portable transforms return new arrays; native point/output alias is covered, partial matrix/output overlap is excluded.
Managed replay compiled only; no game launch and no command-use credit.
